<?php
function warning180($severity180, $message180) {
    global $x180, $warnings180;
    ++$warnings180;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings180, ':', $message180, '|';
    $x180 = 3.5;
    if ($warnings180 === 2) { $x180 = 4.5; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst180(int $first180, int &$second180) {
    echo 'value-body:', $first180, ':', $second180, ':', $GLOBALS['x180'], '|';
    return $second180;
}
function referenceFirst180(int &$first180, int $second180) {
    echo 'reference-body:', $first180, ':', $second180, ':', $GLOBALS['x180'], '|';
    return $second180;
}
set_error_handler('warning180');
$x180 = 1.5;
$warnings180 = 0;
$got180 = valueFirst180(second180: $x180, first180: $x180);
echo 'value-result:', $got180, ':', $x180, '|';
$x180 = 1.5;
$warnings180 = 0;
$got180 = referenceFirst180(second180: $x180, first180: $x180);
echo 'reference-result:', $got180, ':', $x180, '|';
$x180 = 1.5;
$warnings180 = 0;
referenceFirst180(second180: $x180, first180: $x180);
echo 'ignored:', $x180, '|';
purpose: Named source sends reverse signature order. Actual formal receive order and mode still produce VAL-first private1/currentREF3, and REF-first current4.5/privateVAL1, using one caller CV and both used/ignored calls.

<?php
function warning180($severity180, $message180) {
    global $x180, $warnings180, $original180;
    ++$warnings180;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings180, ':', $message180, '|';
    $x180 = 3.5;
    if ($warnings180 === 2) { $x180 = 4.5; throw $original180; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst180(int $first180, int &$second180) { echo 'body|'; return $second180; }
function referenceFirst180(int &$first180, int $second180) { echo 'body|'; return $second180; }
$original180 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning180');
$x180 = 1.5;
$warnings180 = 0;
$destination180 = 91;
try { $destination180 = valueFirst180(second180: $x180, first180: $x180); }
catch (Throwable $caught180) {
    echo 'value-caught:', (int)($caught180 === $original180), ':', (int)($caught180->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|';
}
$x180 = 1.5;
$warnings180 = 0;
try { $destination180 = referenceFirst180(second180: $x180, first180: $x180); }
catch (Throwable $caught180) {
    echo 'reference-caught:', (int)($caught180 === $original180), ':', (int)($caught180->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|';
}

<?php
function warning180($severity180, $message180) {
    global $x180, $throw180, $original180;
    echo 'warning:', $message180, '|';
    $x180 = 3.5;
    if ($throw180) { throw $original180; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst180(int $first180, int &$second180) { echo 'body|'; return $second180; }
function referenceFirst180(int &$first180, int $second180) { echo 'body|'; return $second180; }
$original180 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning180');
$x180 = 1.5;
$throw180 = false;
$destination180 = 91;
try { $destination180 = valueFirst180(second180: $x180); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught180) { echo 'value-hole:', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|'; }
$x180 = 1.5;
try { $destination180 = referenceFirst180(second180: $x180); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught180) { echo 'reference-hole:', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|'; }
$x180 = 1.5;
$throw180 = false;
$destination180 = 91;
try { $destination180 = valueFirst180(first180: $x180); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught180) { echo 'value-missing:', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|'; }
$x180 = 1.5;
try { $destination180 = referenceFirst180(first180: $x180); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught180) { echo 'reference-missing:', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|'; }
$x180 = 1.5;
$throw180 = true;
try { $destination180 = valueFirst180(first180: $x180); }
catch (Throwable $caught180) {
    echo 'value-caught:', (int)($caught180 === $original180), ':', (int)($caught180->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|';
}
$x180 = 1.5;
try { $destination180 = referenceFirst180(first180: $x180); }
catch (Throwable $caught180) {
    echo 'reference-caught:', (int)($caught180 === $original180), ':', (int)($caught180->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination180, ':', $x180, '|';
}
purpose: Interior named required holes fail in preflight without precision warnings; a named first-slot prefix instead receives before trailingmissing, with VAL/REF writeback and original-handler throw priority.
